source-mcdowell-human-identity.publisher: Advances in Ancient, Biblical, and Near Eastern Research

source-crouch-image-of-god.publisher: Journal of Ancient Near Eastern Religions
source-crouch-image-of-god.verificationDetail: Full article read 2026-11-12 (Nottingham repository preview PDF, JANER 16(1) 2016; direct download returned 403, full text read via the repository preview). Abstract and section 1 Introduction confirm the king as YHWH's representative and counterpart in the battle against chaos; section 3.1 Genesis 1 confirms the royal background of image-of-God language (Esarhaddon as image of Bel/Shamash; Egyptian pharaoh as image of Re; Clines' democratization) and dominion language (rdh, kbsh) as royal terminology; section 3.2 Psalm 8 confirms the royal figure crowned with glory and honor, ruling as YHWH's counterpart; section 4 Conclusions states the reconstruction is 'inevitably speculative' - cite as a contested proposal, never as consensus.
